scope: github.com/example-org/platform monorepo, GitHub Actions, Linear, Slack

vectors.name: Бюджеты и flywheel
vectors.summary: Internal LiteLLM gateway with per-team keys and access to many models; no evidence that measured impact ever unlocked budget.

evidence.claim: LiteLLM proxy with per-team virtual keys and max_budget
No cost-per-PR or cost-per-ticket reporting found
Budget is set yearly per team lead

metric.name: Cost per merged PR
metric.threshold: top: trending down and used in budget decisions
metric.how: spend export not reachable from the workspace

next_steps: Join gateway spend with merged-PR counts and publish cost per PR monthly
Tie the next budget request to that trend

vectors.name: Культура
vectors.summary: Everyone uses agents, but sessions are never shared and PRs rarely link specs; sharing is ad hoc in Slack.

evidence.claim: 2 of the last 50 merged PRs link a spec or an agent session
No postmortem mentions an agent failure
Weekly demo exists but is optional

next_steps: PR template field for spec + session link
Share agent sessions by default in one team first

vectors.name: Онтологии
vectors.summary: MCP connectors for Linear, Notion and GitHub; calls are transcribed but transcripts are not agent-reachable; no ADRs.

evidence.claim: Meeting transcripts live in a notetaker SaaS without API access for agents

metric.name: Query coverage
metric.how: 4/10 drafted questions answered with a source

next_steps: Pipe transcripts into the agent-reachable index
Start an ADR folder and backfill the last 10 decisions

vectors.name: Мясо и вкус
vectors.summary: Root AGENTS.md plus 12 skills with CODEOWNERS; spec template exists; no evals for skills.

evidence.claim: AGENTS.md edited 9 days ago; 12 SKILL.md files
No with/without comparisons for any skill

metric.name: Lesson-closure rate
metric.how: no incident log to join against

next_steps: Add a compound step to postmortems: every fix becomes a rule diff

vectors.name: Автоматизация рутины
vectors.summary: Merge queue with required checks and AI review; Renovate auto-merges patch bumps; agent-authored PR share is small.

evidence.claim: GitHub merge queue + 7 required checks + AI reviewer
11 of 200 merged PRs agent-authored with no human commits

metric.name: Agent PRs merged without human edits
metric.how: 11/200, author is a bot or has an agent co-author trailer and no human commits

next_steps: Benchmark one minion side by side before scaling

vectors.name: Агентская инклюзивность
vectors.summary: Agents run on laptops with personal tokens; one cloud agent in CI; secrets come from .env files; no agent accounts.

evidence.claim: CI agent uses a human PAT
Getting the agent into the data warehouse took ~2 days via ticket

metric.name: Median time-to-access
metric.threshold: weak >1h · medium minutes with approval · top <5 min, no click

next_steps: Replace the PAT with a GitHub App
Move secrets to a broker so agents never see raw values

priority.why: Weakest ray, tied with inclusivity and first in the default order: without shared sessions and spec links, no flywheel evidence or ontology habit can form.
Laptop-only agents with personal tokens cap automation regardless of CI quality.
Transcripts and decisions outside agent reach keep automated PRs code-only.
The gateway exists; the missing piece is cost per outcome to justify growth.

open_questions.q: Has anyone received more budget because they proved an AI investment paid off?
When an agent last broke something: a written blameless account, or a quiet revert?

notes: Fictional example for the template. Scores follow references/rubric.md anchors.
